outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: Singleton births in Hungary between 1996 and 2018 (4,091 with type 1 diabetes, 1,879,183 controls)
finding: While the rates of small for gestational age, NICU admissions, and low Apgar scores improved over time in pregnancies complicated by type 1 diabetes, other adverse outcomes remained significantly higher compared to controls.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates decreased over time in pregnancies complicated by type 1 diabetes, with the difference compared to controls becoming non-significant after 2009.
